snippet.description: Jaafar Jackson, nephew of Michael Jackson, is set to play the music icon in a biopic that promises to tell the King of Pop's story. His casting owes to his proven talent rather than just his family ties. In an Interview Magazine feature, Jaafar shared with Miles Teller that his journey towards this role began with a voice note to producer Graham King in 2020, a moment that proved to be a catalyst. Since then, years of dedicated and private preparation have followed, with Jaafar delving into both the physical movements and the emotional and personality nuances of Michael.
